name: TV8-spot-lost
note: A spot's walk leads the party to the pixel's middle, not the spot.

name: TV8-asked-away
note: A member across the map is asked to walk with the leader.

name: TV8-asked-forever
old: if (now - tw.at > PARTY_WALK_ASK_MS) return null;   // too old to be asked about
note: A member who comes near hours later is asked about an old walk.

name: TV8-no-means-yes
note: A member who said no is walked anyway.

name: TV8-never-halts
old: if (tw.h != null && tw.h >= (mine.go ?? -Infinity)) return journeying ? 'halt' : null;
note: The leader stops and the members walk on.

name: TV8-never-again
note: Once halted, the party never sets out together again.

name: TV8-own-journey-stopped
old: if (!tw) return journeying && mine.yes && mine.at != null ? 'halt' : null;
note: A member's own journey is stopped when the leader has none.

name: TV8-old-stop-halts
old: for (const s of stops ?? []) if (Number.isFinite(s) && /** @type {number} */ (s) > tw.go) return true;
new: for (const s of stops ?? []) if (Number.isFinite(s)) return true;
note: A member's stop from before the last set-out halts the party again and again.

name: TV8-walk-stripped
new: if (false) out.tw = { x: tw.x, y: tw.y,
note: The relay strips the leader's walk.

name: TV8-half-a-spot
old: const spotOk = tw && ((tw.sx == null && tw.sz == null) || (Number.isInteger(tw.sx) && Number.isInteger(tw.sz)
new: const spotOk = tw && ((tw.sx == null || tw.sz == null) || (Number.isInteger(tw.sx) && Number.isInteger(tw.sz)
note: A walk with half a spot goes to a spot nobody named.

name: TV8-stop-stripped
note: A member's stop never reaches the leader.

name: TV8-any-relay
note: The walk is offered through a relay that strips it - members asked of nothing.

name: TV8-alone
note: A leader's walk is proposed to members nowhere near.

name: TV8-leader-no-halt
note: The leader stops and nobody is told.

name: TV8-member-stop-ignored
note: A member fights a band and the party walks on without them.

name: TV8-arrival-halts
note: A member arriving first halts the leader short of the place.

name: TV8-halt-echoed
note: The party's own halt is echoed back as a member's stop.
